display_name: HPML Definition and Escrow Requirement Test
purpose: Tests whether a loan qualifies as a Higher-Priced Mortgage Loan (HPML) per Reg Z §1026.35(a)(1): APOR+1.5pp first-lien, APOR+2.5pp jumbo, APOR+3.5pp subordinate (Dodd-Frank structural thresholds, unchanged since 2014). Applies §1026.35(b)(1) escrow requirement for first-lien HPMLs and checks §1026.35(b)(2) exemptions (rural or underserved small creditor, condo master policy). Consumes art-220 (lookup_reg_z_thresholds) for the pinned HPML threshold table. For HOEPA high-cost triggers (APOR+6.5pp/8.5pp): use test_hoepa_high_cost (art-234), not this node.
